# Value Props

## Master Value Prop

**Proposition:** graph8 is the autonomous revenue system that unifies AI agents, a 7-app sales engagement suite, native CRM, 700M+ contact buyer graph, and a built-in CDP on one platform — so B2B teams can run every motion from first signal to closed revenue without stitching together eight disconnected tools.
**Headline:** One buyer graph. Every revenue motion. Agents do the work. Reps win the moment.
**Target Segment:** B2B revenue teams — Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Leadership, Customer Success, and Developers — at companies from startups to enterprise who are frustrated by tool sprawl, per-seat pricing, and fragmented data that makes every handoff lossy.
**Primary Benefit:** Replace the entire GTM stack — data vendor, sequencer, dialer, AI SDR, CRM, CDP, and content tool — with one unified platform priced by execution, not headcount, so the whole team operates on the same buyer graph with zero reconciliation.
**Supporting Benefits:**
- Free to search 700M+ contacts and 100M+ companies; pay only when graph8 executes work
- Unlimited users on every paid plan — no seat taxes that punish growth
- 15 named AI agents (SDR Agent, Deal Agent, CSM Agent, Agent Twins, Voice AI, and more) run autonomously 24/7 and hand off to humans at the live sales moment
- Two-way sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive means you consolidate or coexist — no forced migration
- Built on 10 years of real B2B outbound data from CIENCE — agents are trained on what actually booked meetings and closed deals
- MCP integration gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code live access to the buyer graph with 150+ tools
- Every agent action is logged to revenue memory — auditable, reversible, governed

**Proof Points:**
- 700M+ verified B2B contacts and 100M+ companies available free to search on every plan
- 30B intent signals processed; approximately 2 billion buying signals per day resolved to real people
- 500+ data source connectors in the built-in CDP
- 15 named AI agents covering every revenue role from SDR to CRO
- 7 integrated sales engagement apps sharing one buyer graph
- Backed by $10M seed funding; built on a decade of CIENCE campaign heritage across 2,500+ B2B brands
- Team plan covers unlimited users for $99/month — eliminating the per-seat tax that compounds with every hire

**Differentiator:** graph8 is the only platform that combines 15 named AI agents, a 7-app sales engagement suite, a native CRM, 700M+ verified B2B contacts, a built-in CDP with 500+ connectors, and intent signals — all on a single buyer graph trained on 10 years of real CIENCE campaign data — and prices by execution usage rather than per-seat licenses.

## Value Pillars

### Item 1

**Pillar:** One Buyer Graph — No More Tool Sprawl
**Description:** Every signal, contact, conversation, deal, and campaign lives on a single buyer graph. There is no export, no reconciliation, no integration glue to maintain. Data that lands on the graph from any surface — Sequencer, Dialer, Signals, Agents, CRM, CDP — is instantly available to every other surface, so the next agent and the next rep always see the full picture.
**Claims:**
- Replaces Apollo/ZoomInfo (data), Outreach/Salesloft (sequencing), Orum/Nooks (dialer), Segment/Rudderstack (CDP), Drift/Intercom (chat), Salesforce/HubSpot (CRM), and Jasper/Copy.ai (content) with one platform
- Every app writes back to the same buyer record — no stale exports, no version drift between tools
- Two-way CRM sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive means existing stacks coexist without data loss
- 500+ CDP connectors ingest every external data source into one unified identity layer
- The Data Tax Calculator shows teams typically save $20K+ per year before a single campaign runs

**Evidence:**
- graph8 ships a native CRM, sequencer, dialer, inbox, chat, meetings, nurture, newsletter, CDP, signals, studio, and AI agents — all on one buyer graph
- Published Data Tax Calculator compares graph8 at $99/month flat against ZoomInfo ($15K/yr), Apollo ($588/user/yr), 6sense ($60K/yr), Orum ($3,600/user/yr), and Chili Piper ($15K/yr) — illustrating $21K+ in annualized savings for a small team
- Unlimited users on the Team plan means adding reps, marketers, and RevOps never increases the platform bill

**Icon:** graph

### Item 2

**Pillar:** AI Agents That Run the Revenue Motion — Humans Win the Moment
**Description:** graph8 deploys 15 named, specialized AI agents that prospect, reply, book, qualify, forecast, draft, and govern — autonomously and around the clock. Agents hand off to humans precisely at the live sales moment, fully briefed, so reps walk into every call as the most prepared person in the room. You set the autonomy lane per agent — Manual, Hybrid, or Autopilot — and change it any time.
**Claims:**
- SDR Agent builds ICP lists, drafts first touches in the rep's voice, handles replies, and books meetings — without a human SDR headcount
- Agent Twins are AI clones of individual reps trained on their deals, writing style, and voice — they leave voicemails, draft replies, and cover reps 24/7
- Voice AI makes and receives calls, qualifies leads, books meetings automatically, and delivers a live transcript to the rep before they join
- Deal Agent preps every call brief with stakeholders, last activity, open objections, next-step play, and talk-track
- CSM Agent monitors every account in the installed base for churn risk 90 days before renewal, then drafts the renewal brief and QBR
- CRO Agent forecasts nightly, flags at-risk deals, surfaces coaching moments, and drafts the operating-cadence agenda
- AI Receptionist handles inbound chat, web forms, email, and phone 24/7 — qualifying leads and booking meetings with zero human involvement until the prospect wants to talk

**Evidence:**
- 15 named agents: SDR Agent, Deal Agent, CSM Agent, CRO Agent, Content Agent, Agent Twins, Voice AI, AI Receptionist, Data Quality Agent, Attribution Agent, Operator Agent, Executor Agent, Research Agent, SEO/AEO Agent, and Control & Safety Agent
- Agent autonomy controls are per-agent and per-channel — founders can put outbound on Autopilot while keeping deal approvals Manual
- Revenue memory logs every agent action with actor, timestamp, and policy reference — making automation auditable and reversible
- All agent actions are visible in My Desk (AE Cockpit) — the ranked daily decision queue that shows meeting prep, interested replies, follow-ups, and at-risk deals with drafted next steps ready for approval

**Icon:** robot

### Item 3

**Pillar:** Verified Buyer Data and Real-Time Intent — Free to Search
**Description:** graph8 ships a live buyer graph of 700M+ verified B2B contacts and 100M+ companies with firmographics, technographics, and conversation history — free to search on every plan. Signals layer on 30B intent records (approximately 2B per day), visitor identification, hiring changes, job changes, and tech stack changes — all resolved to real people and ready to trigger a launch automatically.
**Claims:**
- 700M+ verified contacts and 100M+ companies are free to search, filter, and build lists — no credits consumed for browsing
- Buyer intent, website visitor identification, and hiring signals are free fuel — credits only fire when graph8 executes work
- Waterfall enrichment across multiple providers with pay-on-match pricing — bring your own API keys or use graph8's
- Dynamic audience lists sync automatically to LinkedIn, Google, and Meta — living audiences that update as the market moves, not stale CSVs
- Real-time identity resolution unifies anonymous visitors and known contacts into one buyer record

**Evidence:**
- 30B intent signals in the platform; approximately 2 billion buying signals processed per day
- graph8 Data layer includes Search, Contacts, Companies, Lists, and Enrichment surfaces — all on the same buyer graph used by the agents
- Signals surface: visitor identification, topic-level intent, hiring signals, job changes, and technology stack changes — resolved to real people in real time
- Built on the CIENCE data heritage: 10 years of real B2B outbound across 2,500+ brands provides ground-truth training signal for what buyer behavior actually converts

**Icon:** database

### Item 4

**Pillar:** Execution-Based Pricing — No Per-Seat Tax
**Description:** graph8 is priced by what it executes — sequences sent, calls made, meetings booked, AI actions run — not by how many people are in your workspace. Unlimited users come standard on every paid plan. The whole org, including sales, marketing, RevOps, founders, developers, and agency partners, runs on one bill that never grows just because you hired someone.
**Claims:**
- Unlimited users on the Team plan ($99/month) — invite everyone without a headcount premium
- Search and browse the buyer graph free on every plan — 1,000 contact reveals and 500 execution actions included at signup with no credit card
- MCP Unlimited at $25/user gives unlimited contact data in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code
- Credits are consumed only when graph8 does work: reveals, enrichments, sequences sent, calls placed, meetings booked, AI generation runs
- Month-to-month, no annual lock-in — cancel any time; credits never expire

**Evidence:**
- Three published pricing tiers: Pay as you go (free to start, $0.05/credit), MCP Unlimited (~$25/user), and Team plan (~$99/month for unlimited users)
- The Data Tax Calculator on graph8.com demonstrates that a small team replacing ZoomInfo, Apollo, 6sense, Orum, and Chili Piper could save $21K+ annually before any execution savings are counted
- No feature gating: every tier unlocks voice, enrichment, sequencer, campaigns, desktop, and CDP — no upsell tiers hiding key capabilities

**Icon:** dollar

### Item 5

**Pillar:** Developer-First Infrastructure — Revenue as Code
**Description:** graph8 is a GTM developer platform. The same buyer graph, agents, and revenue primitives available in the UI are fully accessible via REST API (150+ endpoints), JavaScript SDK (25+ modules), CLI (143 commands), and an MCP server (150+ tools) for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code. AI-native teams build their entire GTM stack — data, site, campaigns, CRM — on one programmable infrastructure.
**Claims:**
- One API key, four interfaces: REST, SDK, CLI, and MCP — same auth, same data, same credit balance
- MCP server exposes 150+ graph8 tools to any agent in Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT — including CRM writes, sequence launches, and enrichment
- Drop-in React components (Revenue UI) let product teams embed visitor ID, AI copilot, scheduling, and progressive forms into their own apps
- Data Pipelines CDP with 500+ source connectors, JavaScript event transformations, schema governance, and reverse ETL to 500+ destinations
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec, test keys, sandbox, and audit logs available before production access — build against the live surface without commitment

**Evidence:**

- MCP server supports Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, ChatGPT, n8n, LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, and OpenAI Agents SDK
- Workbench provides a spreadsheet-like interface where agents fill columns intelligently — enrichment and GTM automation without code for non-developers
- Workflow Builder supports multi-step automations triggered by buyer signals or schedules, with optional human approval gates at any step

**Icon:** code

### Item 6

**Pillar:** Campaign-Ready Content and Personalization — Studio to Launch
**Description:** Studio learns the business from one URL, builds 44 intelligence documents (brand, ICPs, messaging, competitive positioning), then generates deployable assets — sequences, newsletters, ad copy, landing pages, and case studies — all in the company's brand voice. Tailor injects personalized HTML per visitor segment without CMS edits. The Content Agent runs SEO and AEO to ensure the brand ranks in search and gets cited by AI answer engines.
**Claims:**
- Paste one URL — Studio builds the full strategy and generates every campaign deliverable in one session

- Landing pages, newsletters, ad copy, case studies, whitepapers, and battle cards generated as deployable assets — not just drafts to clean up

- SEO and AEO Agent generates pillar pages and answer-engine content so the brand ranks in both traditional search and AI-generated responses

**Evidence:**

### Item 7

**Pillar:** Governed Autonomy — Safe at Enterprise Scale
**Description:** graph8 ships enterprise governance as a first-class feature: SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, audit logs on every agent and human action, human-in-the-loop approval lanes per surface and region, regional data residency (US, EU, APAC, self-hosted), SOC 2 Type II certification, and a revenue memory layer that makes every action logged, auditable, and reversible.
